f.title: Establish and follow written procedures for handling all written and oral drug product complaints
f.statement: Written procedures describing the handling of all written and oral complaints regarding a drug product shall be established and followed.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Have the quality control unit review complaints about possible specification failures and decide if an investigation under 211.192 is needed
f.statement: The complaint procedures shall include provisions for review by the quality control unit of any complaint involving the possible failure of a drug product to meet any of its specifications and, for such drug products, a determination as to the need for an investigation in accordance with 21 CFR 211.192.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products

f.title: Review each complaint to determine whether it is a serious and unexpected adverse drug experience reportable to FDA
f.statement: The complaint procedures shall include provisions for review to determine whether the complaint represents a serious and unexpected adverse drug experience which is required to be reported to FDA in accordance with 21 CFR 310.305 and 514.80.
f.topic: Adverse drug experience screening of complaints
f.applicability: Human drug products (reportable under 21 CFR 310.305) and new animal drugs (21 CFR 514.80)
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up; Medical review; Reporting policy

f.title: Keep a written record of each complaint in a designated drug product complaint file
f.statement: A written record of each complaint shall be maintained in a file designated for drug product complaints.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Data integrity & records

f.title: Keep the complaint file at the manufacturing, processing or packing site, or at another facility where it is readily available for inspection
f.statement: The drug product complaint file shall be maintained at the establishment where the drug product involved was manufactured, processed or packed, or may be maintained at another facility if the written records in it are readily available for inspection at that other facility.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Retain complaint records until at least 1 year after expiry or 1 year after receipt, whichever is longer (3 years after distribution for exempt OTC products)
f.statement: Written complaint records involving a drug product shall be maintained until at least 1 year after the expiration date of the drug product, or 1 year after the date that the complaint was received, whichever is longer. For certain OTC drug products lacking expiration dating because they meet the exemption criteria under 21 CFR 211.137, the records shall be maintained for 3 years after distribution of the drug product.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products
f.exceptions: OTC drug products lacking expiration dating under 211.137: 3 years after distribution.

f.title: Record product name and strength, lot number, complainant name, nature of complaint and reply, where known
f.statement: The written complaint record shall include the following information, where known: the name and strength of the drug product, lot number, name of complainant, nature of complaint, and reply to complainant.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Where a 211.192 investigation is conducted, record its findings and follow-up in the complaint record

f.title: Keep the investigation record, or a copy, at the establishment where the investigation occurred
f.statement: The record, or a copy of the record, of the 211.192 investigation shall be maintained at the establishment where the investigation occurred, in accordance with 21 CFR 211.180(c).
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products

f.title: Where no 211.192 investigation is conducted, record the reason and the name of the person who decided it was not needed
f.statement: Where an investigation under 21 CFR 211.192 is not conducted, the written complaint record shall include the reason that an investigation was found not to be necessary and the name of the responsible person making that determination.
f.applicability: Drug products subject to current good manufacturing practice (21 CFR Part 211), including marketed prescription and OTC drug products
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Quality system & CAPA
